All work is committed and the tree is clean. Final report follows.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/services/agentcore/runtime.py` — new `stop_runtime_session(client, *, runtime_arn, session_id, qualifier=None)` wrapper over data-plane `StopRuntimeSession`.
- `backend/app/services/invoke.py` — new `stop_agent_session(agent, session_id, workspace)`: same method dispatch and `data_client` as the invoke chain; harness / discovered-harness → 409 `chat.session_stop_unsupported`; `ResourceNotFoundException` → `{ended: true, already_ended: true}`; other ClientErrors propagate. Added `RUNTIME_SESSION_METHODS`.
- `backend/app/routers/chat.py` — new `POST /api/chat/{agent_id}/sessions/{session_id}/stop` (404 `chat.session_not_found` for another agent's/workspace's session, stamps `ended_at`, keeps the row); `list_sessions` returns `ended_at`; `_track_session` clears `ended_at` when a new turn lands under the same id.
- `backend/app/models/ledger.py` — `ChatSession.ended_at` nullable column.
- `backend/app/core/db.py` — `_migrate` adds `ALTER TABLE chat_sessions ADD COLUMN ended_at DATETIME` (covered by the existing migration test).
- `backend/app/core/errors.py` — `RetryableConflictException` → 409 `aws.conflict` in `AWS_ERROR_MAP`.
- `backend/app/core/route_policy.py` — new POST registered as `MEMBER`, like the other chat routes.
- `backend/tests/test_chat_session_stop.py` — 12 new hermetic tests (stubbed data-plane client).
- `backend/tests/test_errors_aws.py` — parametrized case + closed-list set include the new code.
- `backend/app/services/workspace_iam.py`, `infra/stacks/base_stack.py` — `bedrock-agentcore:StopRuntimeSession` added next to `InvokeAgentRuntime` in the `ABTestOrchestration` statement, kept in lock-step.
- `frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx` — END SESSION button beside NEW SESSION; END action per history row; both shared `Btn` with `disabledReason` (no session / harness agent / already ended / in flight); success toast; a successful end of the current session resets via `newSession()`; rows show ENDED and a `data-ended` attribute.
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `ChatSessionInfo`, `ChatSessionStopResult`, `api.listChatSessions`, `api.stopChatSession`.
- `frontend/src/locales/en/common.json`, `zh-CN/common.json` — 9 `chatPage.*` keys + 2 `apiErrors.*` keys each.
- `frontend/src/theme/app.css` — `.histrow-line` / `.histrow-act` row layout so the row button and the END button are siblings, not nested.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — new Console Chat API section (route table incl. the stop route semantics), error map row updated.
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — explicit session end + version-pinning motivation in the invoke-chain section, `chat_sessions` ledger row, error map, `ABTestOrchestration` count 18 → 19.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `-k "session and stop"` tests: runtime agent → wrapper called with the agent ARN + session id, 200 `{ended: true, already_ended: false}`, `ended_at` set; `ResourceNotFoundException` stub → 200 `already_ended: true`; harness and discovered-harness → 409 `chat.session_stop_unsupported`; other agent's session → 404; other workspace → 404; `list_sessions` returns `ended_at`. Extras: RetryableConflict → 409 `aws.conflict`, second stop keeps the first `ended_at`, new turn clears `ended_at`, discovered runtime qualifies.
- ✅ `test_route_policy.py` + `test_client_funnel.py` pass.
- ✅ Frontend: END SESSION disabled with reason when no session or harness agent (`endReason` predicate drives both `disabled` and `disabledReason`), enabled once `sessionId` exists after a turn; rows show ENDED. tsc, lint, both i18n scripts clean. Verified by code and static gates only, no browser run.
- ✅ Docs: route entry in `api.md` + `api.zh-CN.md`; explicit-end sentence in both architecture docs; IAM action added in `workspace_iam.py` and `base_stack.py`; the docs' only action enumeration (`ABTestOrchestration` count) updated.
- ✅ `make verify` PASS (infra ruff+pytest included).
- ⚠️ Live AWS check: not exercised, as declared. No AWS calls were made; the stub covers the data-plane client. Offline botocore model confirms `StopRuntimeSession` input/output/error shapes and that neither `bedrock-agentcore` nor `bedrock-agentcore-control` has an operation naming both Harness and Session.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **IAM placement is a judgment call.** The repo has no console-role definition: the hub console runs on the instance role, and the cross-account spoke role (`infra/spoke/launchpad-workspace-role.yaml`) already grants `bedrock-agentcore:*`, so it needed no change. The only place `InvokeAgentRuntime` is granted "for the platform" is the `ABTestOrchestration` statement on the shared execution role, which `architecture.md` itself describes as platform actions that had leaked onto the workload role. I followed the brief and added `StopRuntimeSession` there (derived policy + CDK in lock-step, docs count updated). If the host prefers not to widen the workload role, revert that one hunk in each file and the "19 actions" doc edit; nothing else depends on it.
- **`RetryableConflictException` added to `AWS_ERROR_MAP`.** The brief said the existing mapping maps it to 409, but the code did not have it. Adding it is the minimal way to make the described semantics true; the closed-list test and both API docs were updated.
- **Revive semantics.** A turn posted under an ended session id (possible by restoring an ended session from the rail) starts a fresh runtime session with the same id, so the router clears `ended_at` on that turn. The brief did not specify this; it keeps the rail's "ended" label truthful.
- **Frontend has no test runner**, so the UI behaviour is verified by tsc/lint/build and code reading, not by a browser run.
- `ruff format` reports drift in `invoke.py` (pre-existing lines) and in my test file's compact kwargs style (matching `test_chat_api.py`). The gate runs `ruff check` only, which is clean.
